# Musikli

> Musikli is a free music puzzle game for Android where you tap winding notes off a packed board, and every note you free plays the next part of a famous public-domain melody.

## Facts

- Platform: Android (Google Play). Price: free. Genre: puzzle, music, casual.
- Content: 50 levels in 5 worlds, each built on a different famous melody.
- Modes: level campaign, daily challenge, weekly champions leaderboard.
- Works offline. No account required.
- All melodies are public domain; all sounds are synthesized on the device (no audio recordings).
- No board can become unwinnable: freeing a note never blocks another note.
- Developer: Musikli Games.

## Worlds

- World 1, First Notes: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star; Mary Had a Little Lamb; Frere Jacques; London Bridge Is Falling Down; Row, Row, Row Your Boat; Old MacDonald Had a Farm; Jingle Bells; Ode to Joy; Yankee Doodle; Oh! Susanna
- World 2, Campfire Songs: When the Saints Go Marching In; Oh My Darling, Clementine; Auld Lang Syne; Amazing Grace; Silent Night; We Wish You a Merry Christmas; Deck the Halls; Joy to the World; Greensleeves; Scarborough Fair
- World 3, Concert Hall: Fur Elise; Eine kleine Nachtmusik; Minuet in G; Brahms' Lullaby; Canon in D; Spring (The Four Seasons); Symphony No. 5; William Tell Overture; Can-Can; Turkish March
- World 4, World Tour: La Cucaracha; Korobeiniki; Sakura Sakura; Londonderry Air (Danny Boy); Habanera (Carmen); Toreador Song (Carmen); The Blue Danube; Bridal Chorus; La donna e mobile; Morning Mood (Peer Gynt)
- World 5, Grand Finale: In the Hall of the Mountain King; Swan Lake; Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy; Toccata and Fugue in D minor; Symphony No. 40; Moonlight Sonata; Ride of the Valkyries; The Entertainer; 1812 Overture; Flight of the Bumblebee

## FAQ

### How do you play Musikli?
Tap a note to send it straight ahead off the board. If another note or a rest-stone is in its way it bumps back and you lose a heart. Clear every note before you run out of hearts or time.

### Is the music in Musikli copyrighted?
No. Every melody is in the public domain: traditional tunes and works by composers who died more than 100 years ago. All sounds are generated by the game itself.

### Does Musikli work offline?
Yes. All 50 levels and the daily challenge work without a connection. Only accounts and the global leaderboard need the internet.

### Is Musikli free?
Yes. The game is free to play and can be played as a guest without creating an account.

### Which melodies are in Musikli?
50 well-known tunes, including Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, Ode to Joy, Fur Elise, Eine kleine Nachtmusik, Bridal Chorus, Swan Lake, Flight of the Bumblebee.

### How do I delete my Musikli account?
In the app, open Settings and tap Delete account. You can also request deletion by e-mail.
